settings.label: Enable swipeable image gallery on cards
settings.info: Lets shoppers swipe through a product's images on collection, home and search cards. Desktop keeps hover-to-peek and adds dots + arrows.

settings.content: Shimmering corner tag on the product gallery showing the on-model fit. Per-product values can be set in each product's metafields (Model height / Model size); the defaults below apply to every other product.

settings.label: Default model height
settings.info: Shown when a product has no Model height metafield. Leave blank to hide the height.

settings.label: Default model size
settings.info: Shown when a product has no Model size metafield. Leave blank to hide the size.

settings.content: Rotating pill in the top-left of product images cycling through the product's Tag 1–Tag 4 metafields (custom.tag_1 … custom.tag_4), in order, skipping blanks. Entries like "240 GSM" get the fabric-weight chip styling; a "SAVE NN%" entry is added automatically while the product is on sale (always shown as a percent). Maximum 5 entries. When disabled, the previous static badges (GSM, product label, sale) are shown instead.

settings.label: Seconds per entry
settings.info: How long each entry stays visible before sliding to the next.

settings.content: Compact live-activity strip on product pages (replaces the Money Back Promise card slot). The stat flips between "N views in last hour" (the all-time view count) and "N sold last hour" — both read from product metafields refreshed hourly from analytics; the "last hour" wording is display text only. Turn it off, or when a product has no stat to show, the Money Back Promise card appears instead.

settings.label: Minimum sold count to display
settings.info: Products below this hide the "sold last hour" line. 0 = show from the first sale (products with zero sales never show it).

settings.label: Minimum all-time views to display
settings.info: Products below this hide the "views in last hour" line (shows the all-time view count). 0 = show from the first view.

settings.label: Enable Virtual Try-On
settings.info: Master switch. Off: no try-on button on any product page, no try-on scripts or styles loaded on any page, and no try-on modal. Off by default, and set per theme — a preview theme can run it while the live theme does not.

settings.content: Single source of truth for the spend-reward ladder, the free-shipping threshold and the trust/delivery copy. The cart, the cart drawer, the PDP reward bar and the PDP sticky buy bar all read these, so a value changed here changes everywhere at once.

DISPLAY ONLY. These must match the automatic discounts in Admin — the theme cannot grant a discount. Tier 2 and tier 3 are the flat amounts; each combines with the tier 1 percentage but never with each other.

settings.label: Tier 1 — percentage off
settings.info: The percentage applied from tier 1 upward. Combines with the tier 2 or tier 3 flat amount.

settings.label: Show the offer rail on collection pages
settings.info: A swipeable strip of offer cards above the filters, listing the tiers above plus Buy 2 Get 1 and the prepaid discount. It states what is on offer and never claims anything is applied — a collection page has no cart to reason from. Shown on every collection that has products in it.

settings.label: Offer rail — prepaid ₹ off
settings.info: The prepaid card's amount. This one is applied by Razorpay at checkout, NOT by Shopify, so it must match the prepaid banner in the cart and cart-drawer sections. Set to 0 to drop the card. Never shown to US visitors: they go to Shopify's native checkout, where Razorpay does not run.

settings.label: Enable Buy 2 Get 1 surfaces
settings.info: Shows the offer on the PDP, in the banner, and as the piece ladder in the cart and drawer. Must move together with the automatic Buy X Get Y discount in Admin → Discounts (buy 2, get 1 at 100% off, once per order, combines with order discounts) — untick this AND deactivate that discount to end the offer. While the free piece applies, checkout drops the ₹300/₹700 tiers in its favour and the ladder says so.

settings.label: Show a second "Buy now" action
settings.info: Off by default. The bar leads with one clear action; a second button beside it splits the decision and reads as marketplace rather than brand. Turn on to restore the pairing — checkout still routes through the existing size sheet.

settings.label: Mark a size as low stock at or below
settings.info: Units remaining. Most items sit at 1–4, so a threshold of 3 would mark nearly every size and the signal would stop meaning anything. The "Only N left" line under the price still appears at 3 or fewer once a size is chosen.

settings.label: Size chart page
settings.info: The page the buy bar's "Size guide" opens. Leave empty to use the page with the handle size-chart. Needed because the variant picker's own size-chart setting cannot be read while that block is hidden.

settings.content: Must match the free-shipping rate condition in Settings → Shipping and delivery. Shopify tests this against the order total AFTER discounts.

settings.label: Star rating
settings.info: Shown in the cart and drawer trust bar, e.g. 4.7 renders as ⭐ 4.7/5.

settings.label: Orders delivered
settings.info: Rendered in small caps by the theme — enter it in sentence case.

settings.label: Low-stock badge below
settings.info: Show "Only N left" when remaining stock is at or under this number.

settings.content: DISPLAY ONLY. Visitors browsing in the United States market see prices converted to USD at the rate below — every order is still charged in INR (their US-market price) via Razorpay. Checkout, emails and order history stay INR.

settings.label: Show USD prices to US visitors
INR per USD
settings.info: Displayed price = INR price ÷ this rate. Set it a little BELOW the market rate (market was ~95 in Aug 2026): the customer's bank adds a 2–3% foreign-transaction fee on top of the INR charge, so a slightly lower rate keeps the displayed dollars honest rather than optimistic. Spend thresholds round up so a reward never unlocks later than displayed. Review monthly.
